verdict.rationale: Paperspace is a GPU cloud platform, not an agent, so publishing an official MCP server is a fair question to ask. The evidence documents only a REST API, an OpenAPI spec, a CLI, a JavaScript SDK and an llms.txt file. None of it mentions an official MCP server, and those developer building blocks earn no credit toward this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
